text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 194 vials of norepinephrine bitartrate 1 mg/mL 4 mL with 33.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 134 vials of the same presentation with 21.9 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include norepinephrine bitartrate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. Multiple suppliers are available but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants, which limits supply chain verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Anthea Pharma Private Limited as primary purchase option; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
2. Buyer to evaluate BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary purchase option; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
3. Buyer to evaluate BIOCON PHARMA INC. as tertiary purchase option; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
4. Buyer to evaluate Baxter Healthcare Company and Baxter Healthcare Corporation as additional options; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
5. Buyer to request manufacturing site disclosure from all potential suppliers before purchase commitment; requires Quality Assurance approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below 14 days on hand at either site.
